content: Compression sportswear, such as compression tights, is specifically engineered to provide athletes with both physical and psychological advantages over their competitors. The primary benefits of wearing compression tights include the following: They enhance athletic performance by preserving the ability to perform repeated jumps effectively. They minimize unnecessary muscle movement and vibration, while directing muscle activity more efficiently. They lower the risk of sports-related injuries by providing targeted support to muscles and joints. They help regulate body temperature and wick away moisture, maintaining optimal thermal comfort during physical activity. They reduce the accumulation of creatine kinase, a biomarker associated with muscle tissue damage, thereby protecting muscle integrity. They accelerate the muscle repair process, shortening recovery time after intense physical exertion. They alleviate muscle soreness during post-workout recovery, promoting faster and more comfortable recuperation. As an alternative to compression stockings, they can be worn during prolonged flights to mitigate the risk of deep vein thrombosis (DVT), which is caused by blood pooling in the lower extremities. These benefits collectively enable athletes to train and compete for longer durations and at higher intensities, optimizing their overall performance and endurance.
